Metadata.title: Sergey Belyakov — Full-stack developer
Metadata.description: Portfolio of Sergey Belyakov, a full-stack web developer: websites, web apps and motion experiences.

Hero.manifesto: I design and build fast, beautiful websites and web apps — from the first sketch to production.

Work.label: Selected work
Work.title: Things I've built
Work.intro: Products I designed, built and shipped end to end, from the first sketch to production.

Services.label: Services
Services.title: What I can do for you
Services.intro: One developer for the whole product: interface, server, database and launch.

frontend.title: Frontend development
frontend.description: Fast, accessible interfaces in React and Next.js, pixel-perfect from Figma, with motion that feels right.

backend.title: Backend & APIs
backend.description: Databases, authentication, payments and integrations: reliable server logic that grows with the product.

fullstack.title: Full-stack products
fullstack.description: From idea to launch: I plan the architecture, build the product end to end and ship it to production.

motion.title: WebGL & motion websites
motion.description: Immersive sites with scroll scenes, shaders and micro-interactions that make a brand memorable.

ecommerce.title: E-commerce
ecommerce.description: Online stores with a fast catalog, checkout and payments, built to sell and easy to manage.

Stack.label: Stack
Stack.title: Tools I build with
Stack.intro: A modern, proven stack. I choose what fits the product, not what's trendy.

Process.label: Process
Process.title: How we'll work together
Process.intro: A clear process with no surprises: you always know what is happening and what comes next.

brief.title: Brief
brief.description: We talk through your goals, audience and constraints. I come back with a clear scope, timeline and estimate.

design.title: Design
design.description: Structure first, then a visual design in Figma that you can click through before any code is written.

build.title: Development
build.description: I build in short iterations with a live preview link, so you see progress every few days and can steer early.

launch.title: Launch
launch.description: Testing on real devices, performance and SEO checks, then deployment to your domain with analytics in place.

support.title: Support
support.description: After launch I fix issues, add features and keep dependencies up to date, so the product stays fast and secure.
